name: OpenMovements
description: Open movements from Priority (mirror): every unmatched movement per customer by due month — the base of the aging report
technicalDescription: Mirror of Priority's unmatched customer movements (plan 04.11, part A). Written ONLY by PullOpenMovements (morning pull 06:00, the re-pull after the receipts run, and the manual button); each pull replaces the snapshot of every customer it returns. Nothing points at a movement row: notes point at customer + dueMonth, so replacing rows is safe. Includes invoices, receipts on account, partial balances and journal entries. amount > 0 = debt, < 0 = credit. dueMonth = YYYY-MM of dueDate. Until the Priority API exists the source is a test source derived from TEST-001..029 (source test-fixture), so the aging report and the customer card show the same totals.

columns.name: movementId
columns.description: Priority key of the movement (unique per customer)

columns.name: customer
columns.description: Link to the customer row (real reference); customerCode and customerName are kept beside it for agents and display

columns.name: dueMonth
columns.description: Due month YYYY-MM, the aging report column

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Open amount in ILS, 2 decimals: positive = debt, negative = credit

columns.name: details
columns.description: Priority details / description of the movement

columns.name: importBatchId
columns.description: ImportBatches row of the pull that wrote it
